items.title: Recommended Discovery Focus Areas
items.verbatim_quote: Recommended discovery focus: (1) Salesforce CRM utilization audit — what does the bank actually use it for? Who are the users? Is there an admin? (2) Tealium CDP activation review — are any audiences/segments created? What downstream systems consume the data? (3) Fiserv feature inventory — which Architect and Signature features are active vs available but unused? (4) Telephony consolidation — which of the 4 vendors are active vs legacy remnants?
